S.FORM: == yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci 翼地效應機 == yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci "Ground-effect vehicle" u sakay sasa nu lalaan mubahelay atu mubahelay nu balunga, u micukaymasay tu yi-ti-siaw-ing mubahelay a sapibahel nu kikayan, mipulung tu hikuki a sibaniay nu balungaan tu picidekan a sapibahel nu kikay. sakacaay ka lecad nu hikukian, mahiniay a sapibahel nu kikayan angangan u sakay sasa mubahel, u micapiay tu lalaan, nananuman mibahel, mangalay tu hamin nu demiad micukaymas tu yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci mikawaw, atu sibaniay a balunga tu sakacaay ka lecad, ya sibaniay nu balungaan u udip tu ku pabaliay, nika uyni u yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci u yi-ti-siaw-ing ku pabaniay. sakacaay kalecad nu babahelan nu kikayan itida sa micapi tu pinaay a cean hakiya tu pina nu bataan a cean nu talakaw ku nipibahel, acaay paceba sa misumad tu talakaw. ina pabanien nanay a balunga kanca kasasululan u yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci, tatengan caay kalecad ku sangan nu mahiniay a balungaan. 翼地效應機(Ground-effect vehicle), . sakay bahel nu sanga飛行原理 sapilaylayan a nipibahelan nu kikay micapi tu lala atu nanum mibahel sa, kaydaan nu bali i sakubat pasayda i nikudan ku bali, ayda u sasa atu nanum idaw ku naicelangan miwawies, silaad tu nanum mahida mikiadidiay tu 1/2 nu talakaw a mabahel, hamin nu balunga a uipan nu ba'ket macunus ku tabaki, sakatapabaw macunus, adidi ku sapiwawies, mamieputay tu sapibahel a kikayan ina sakubad mahetik. mihiniay a kikay taneng miwawies misaadidi' tu sapibahel, kya taneng mikikaka tu mabahelay i tapukuannanay a sapipuudaw nu u-li sin-sing, saan ku ke-sye-ciw tu mahiniay u yi-ti-siaw-ing, nikahinian idaw tu ku ti-siaw-hua-sin ngingicuan. . ing-yun應用 yu mahida namitaneng tu tu siw-se H-4 ta-li-sen, tatengan apuyu ku nibahelan mahetik tu. anganganan nu wenday i tawya nu hikuki tu sapihaka caay ka taneng. 早年的嘗試有休斯H-4 . tabakiay sakaynanum nu balungaan大型水空艇 caysiwwalsep mihcaan, naayaway a Su-len nikinkiwan nu nipatahekalan tu sediw sananay a cacuduhan nu yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci, u nikabahelan tu ba'ket makaala tu caysepsepsep kun-tun, yu mahida u malepacaway henay, ya amuhun nu kanatalan misuayaw tu Su-len tu nipakaycaculimekan mitanam tu mahiniay a nikabahelan caay kaw katinengan, uyda a cacay ku sakay " sakaylabu nu mahicaay i bayunanay a kuyuan" palecad han pangangan tu nu hitay a yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci. 在1980年代, . sakay yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci tu nipisikian itida namin i nananuman, dayhan i nanum tu sakay lala kapah ku nikasadit inai' ku mamibatelu, anu caay cukaymasi, taneng henay sipakayda i nanum nu icelang ahemaw ku ba'ket, anu mubahel madayum. uli-yei-cia ci S-tan-li.Hu-ke' namusakamu tu micidekay nu tabaki, nu tadaba'ketay nu 2000 kun-tun a nadatengan tu yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci, mahiniay a balungaan taneng milakuuyt mitupin tu cacay a malebut nu tademawan, yasuy ku aca kalamkam ku nikatukuh i tataydaan. sadikuday nikinkiwan nu sulin caay tu kalaheci, tusa ku patelac nina yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci cacay sakaysasa' nu nananuman a hikukian, metalaw tu tabakiay nu cakepan, katalawan sawsawni mapatik nu cakep mucelem i bayu, tatenga itida i nikakapah nu bayuan sadikuday yadah ku malawpesay nu nipikinkiwan tu balungaan, sisa sikay bayuan u caayay ka kapah, anu sipitupin tu tuudan hakiya a katuud ku mapatayay, duma a sakalacus u nikaahecid nu bayuan mitai' tu i sasaay nu naman mubahelay nu hikukian a sapisanga, tawyaay a zayliw caay henay ka kapah. . nai'ay nu tademaw a hikuki無人機 tusepcaypic mihcaan ina Cung-kuo hitay mapatahekal nu heni ku sakalecad nu kitidaan a sikalaheciay nai'ay nu tademawan a hikukian, nu ayawan mahida u cacayay nu mibalelihay a balungaan nu mabahelay a lacuna, saan ku duma nu kitakid mahiniay a nikatahekalan nu lalacuan u mamiedis tina hang-mu sakalepacaw nu balungaan u micidekay nu te-hua kakakuwangan, pulungen ku micidekay papatulinen. 2017 . sayaway mala u sakalawpesan a nai'ay nu tademawan, sakay bayuan nu ancin caay kaw sakaetiman, sakay tini i cakepan tunikahetikan taneng tu sa. sapiedisaw tu sakangaay itida i sapitupinaw caay kaw kapahay, mahiniay mitupinay nai' ku kakabalihenawan u ba'ket idaw ku nipikuleced tu nipipadengan tu ba'ketay nu lai-ta, u sapikisa nida u may-cun-tu-pu-le' lei-ta, mahiniay a lei-ta sapisiwwasiw tu i bayuay nu sakay amelikan tu sapitanengan, u tatesulan aw u basud sananay nu tayniay, u amelik nida makaalatu 200 ku sapitanaman, sakay sasaay mahaymaw ku culi nu sapipaadingan, sisa sipakayda i tapukuan tu sapipu't tu adaan idaw ku tuluay a kawawan: : sakacacay tada amilikay nu mubahelay a lacuna, kanahatu kadihan caay tu kalawa. sakatusa u sapihaliyud nu nipibahel putun han ku nipibahel, pacici hank u tapiingan misuayaw tu nikahedawan, dayhan nu mibahelay nu lacuna kya caay pakatepa. sakatulu isasaen ku nipibahel haymaw sa micapi. ka yadah ku nipitupin tu tuudan caay kataneng ku nipitupin tu sapibakuhac a lacuna tu sapibakudang tu balungaan,uyda u yi-ti-siaw-ing taneng miedap tuynian, u cacay nu lasubuan a batad nu i sasaay mitahaway sa, micapi tu lea-ta a sapibahbah nu balungaan atu hun-mu hedawen ku udip nu hikuki palaadidiay nu sunian nu balunga a amelikay nu lacuna, miedis tu sadikudayay nu micapiay tu lacuna. . yi-ti-siaw-ing " Wing-In-Ground effect,WIG" pangangan han tu "Ground effect" atu yi-men-siaw-ing "Wing-In-Surface-Effect,WISE" sapiwawies tu nikabahelan tu bali sapiwada tu nipicumud tu bali, kya taneng mikikaka tu nipibahelan tu nipiwawies a niculilan tu liw-ti-sye-siaw-in: milaylay ku sapibahel a kikayan micapitu lala' atu nanum, nu nikatapabawan atu nikatasasaan macunus ku tabaki, sakatapabaw kasenusa macunu. nu ayawan nu Su-len u mahiniay ku cukaymasen, kinapina tu mikinkiw tu mahiniay yi-ti-siaw-ing sapibahel tatenga mikinkiw tu nipibahelan. 翼地效應(Wing-In-Ground effect, WIG) (Wing-In-Surface-Effect, WISE), . mahiniay nu hikukian atu sapisetset a kadidenga a culil nu bali malalid nu sasa' atu nanum, sa mahini.mahiniay a kawawan tusa ku cacukaymasan: sapisetset a kadideng nipisikian i sasa nu kadidengan pasayda i sasa ku bali, sapicunus tu sakakapah nu muli, kya midepit i lala' ku kadideng sa. . yi-ti-siaw-ing palalekalan翼地效應產生的原因 yi-ti-siaw-ing palalekalan itida i u'-li masasetset henay, saan nu yi-ti-siaw-ing u sakay balian itida i sakubad atu sasa nanum malatalakaway nu sibaniay tu nikatabakiay nu icelangan. nika nikinkiwan tu bali idaw ku sasulitan, saan ku nikatahekalan tu talakaway a banian idaw tu sa, nika sakaysasa nananuman anganganan u sapilawlaw tu yi-cin adiyuc. kanai'an henay nu yi-cin adiyucan, kalimucu' nu sakubadan taneng micapitu nanakamuan, sipakayda kapah ku nipibahel nu hikuki. . yi-ti-siaw-ing hicaen misuayaw ku hikuki a mikawa dayhan sakalecad nu amelik atu sacuduh, micapiay tu nipibahelan nu yi-ti-siaw-ing u udip idaw ku tabakiay a nipicuduhan. sisa ina yi-ti-siaw-ing taneng misatalakaw tu micapiay tu nipibahel nu hikuki a sibalan. nika hucunu hikuki itidasa i pibahelan atu kadebuan micapi tu lala', itini sa a cacay kapah ku sakay yi-ti-siaw-ing. masasetset ku kadideng, misangaay tu kadideng a tademaw kaisa tu tapabaway uyda kuhan u tasasaay. micukaymas tu culil nu bali a nikatasasaan, yu sapisetset nu kadideng anu mungangnw kya mahida tu ku talakaw nu amelki. mangalay a talakaw ku sapicelang, u kadideng atu sasaay bali miwad tu bali. micukaymas tu puo-li-tin-li, miwada tu tatamudungan malatusa ku kakawaw. duma micukaymas tu sasa nu kadideng nipisikian pacici han pacumud i sasa nu kadideng a bali malakakenisan atu caculil nu bali nu sasa a kadidengan, anu amelik ku culil nu bali u sapipenec mawada. .

kikayan, mipulung tu hikuki a sibaniay nu balungaan tu picidekan a sapibahel nu kikay. sakacaay ka lecad nu hikukian, mahiniay a sapibahel nu kikayan angangan u sakay sasa mubahel, u micapiay tu lalaan, nananuman mibahel, mangalay tu hamin nu demiad micukaymas tu yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci mikawaw, atu sibaniay a balunga tu sakacaay ka lecad, ya sibaniay nu balungaan u udip tu ku pabaliay, nika uyni u yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci u yi-ti-siaw-ing ku pabaniay. sakacaay kalecad nu babahelan nu kikayan itida sa micapi tu pinaay a cean hakiya tu pina nu bataan a cean nu talakaw ku nipibahel, acaay paceba sa misumad tu talakaw. ina pabanien nanay a balunga kanca kasasululan u yi-ti-siaw-ing-ci, tatengan caay kalecad ku sangan nu mahiniay a balungaan. 翼地效應機(Ground-effect vehicle), . sakay bahel nu sanga飛行原理 sapilaylayan a nipibahelan nu kikay micapi tu lala atu nanum mibahel sa, kaydaan nu bali i sakubat pasayda i nikudan ku bali, ayda u sasa atu nanum idaw ku naicelangan miwawies, silaad tu mahetik. mihiniay a kikay taneng miwawies misaadidi' tu sapibahel, kya taneng mikikaka tu mabahelay i tapukuannanay a sapipuudaw nu u-li sin-sing, saan ku ke-sye-ciw tu mahiniay u yi-ti-siaw-ing, nikahinian idaw tu ku ti-siaw-hua-sin ngingicuan. . ing-yun應用 yu mahida namitaneng tu tu siw-se H-4 ta-li-sen, tatengan apuyu ku nibahelan mahetik tu. anganganan nu wenday i tawya nu hikuki tu
